targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT entry_score, exit_score, relay_score, overall_score FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = ${test_id_a:sqlstring} LIMIT 1), b AS (SELECT entry_score, exit_score, relay_score, overall_score FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = ${test_id_b:sqlstring} LIMIT 1) SELECT 'Entry' AS metric, (SELECT entry_score FROM a) AS "Server A", (SELECT entry_score FROM b) AS "Server B" UNION ALL SELECT 'Exit', (SELECT exit_score FROM a), (SELECT exit_score FROM b) UNION ALL SELECT 'Relay', (SELECT relay_score FROM a), (SELECT relay_score FROM b) UNION ALL SELECT 'Overall', (SELECT overall_score FROM a), (SELECT overall_score FROM b)
SELECT test_id, asn, as_name, location, provider, distro, ipv4, overall_score, detected_techniques FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = ${test_id_a:sqlstring} LIMIT 1
SELECT test_id, asn, as_name, location, provider, distro, ipv4, overall_score, detected_techniques FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = ${test_id_b:sqlstring} LIMIT 1

SELECT ${test_id_a:sqlstring} AS server, category, method, COUNT(*) AS detections FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id = ${test_id_a:sqlstring} AND method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, method UNION ALL SELECT ${test_id_b:sqlstring}, category, method, COUNT(*) FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id = ${test_id_b:sqlstring} AND method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, method ORDER BY method, category
